text:
sara-finance: Heads up — batch charge for QubitHealth (12 invoices) ran at 09:12 and 4/12 cards returned `DECLINE_FRAUD` from our processor. Not a network decline, looks like issuer flagged. Need plan for retries + customer comms.

mike-payments: Thanks. Can you paste the failing card last4 & processors codes? I can check downstream logs.

sara-finance: failing last4: 4242, 3781, 6011, 1117. Processor code: `FRAUD_SUSPECT_92`. Payment attempt IDs: pay_8a1b.., pay_8a1b.. (I'll DM full IDs).

billing-bot: [system] Payment webhook received: event=payment.failed, count=4, reason=partner_decline, processor_code=FRAUD_SUSPECT_92.

nora-support: Customer (acct: qubit-corp) opened a ticket asking "why did you try to charge our cards?" We should give a clear, non-accusatory message.

mike-payments: Suggestion: 1) Halt auto-retries for these cards for 24h. 2) Try a single manual retry after 24h with different routing (alt-acquirer). 3) Offer invoice link + ACH as fallback. 4) If customer needs, provide one-time credit hold (<$5k) while they sort.

sara-finance: I like that. Proposed customer note (short):

```
Hi QubitHealth — we attempted to process your scheduled invoice but a subset of cards were declined by the issuing bank. No funds were captured. We can retry once tomorrow with an alternate routing, or we can send an invoice link and ACH instructions if you prefer. Please reply with the best option.\n
If we don't hear back in 5 business days, we'll follow our standard collections flow.\n
— Redwood Billing
```

irina-legal: fine, keep it neutral and don't say "fraud". Use "issuing bank declined" like Sara's template. Also keep record of any temporary credit commitments in Zendesk and a billing note.

ben-ops: Approving one-time credit hold up to $8k for QubitHealth while they sort payment method. Add `credit_hold: approved` to account metadata. Ping me after you update.

sara-finance: thanks @ben-ops. I'll: 1) Pause retries for the four cards (actioned) 2) Schedule single alt-route retry at 09:15 UTC tomorrow 3) Send the customer note via support ticket now 4) Create invoice link + ACH instructions if they ask.

mike-payments: For the retry, I'll set routing override to `acquirer=alt-payco` and `max_attempts=1`. Command:

```
/payments retry --payment-ids pay_8a1b... --override acquirer=alt-payco --attempts=1
```

sara-finance: done: paused retries and added a billing note: "Pausing auto retries per ops, alt-route retry scheduled". Ticket updated with template.

nora-support: I posted the template to ticket #4521 and asked if they prefer ACH. Customer replied: "Please send ACH instructions — we'll do that now." :white_check_mark:

mike-payments: Great — I'll cancel the scheduled retry and mark payments to wait for manual collect. Also generating invoice link.

billing-bot: [system] Invoice link created: https://redwood-invoices/local/ln_7c3d — expires in 7 days.

sara-finance: Follow-up checklist created in the account: [credit_hold=approved by ben-ops], [invoice_link=ln_7c3d], [retry_cancelled], [support_tkt=4521]. Leaving note to revisit in 7 days.

irina-legal: make sure ACH instructions are the standard doc (link) and that we don't store raw bank details in slack.

ben-ops: thanks team. Keep me posted if they ask for extended terms.

sara-finance: closing this thread — status: customer opted for ACH, invoice link sent, alt-route retry cancelled, credit hold approved. We'll reconcile once payment clears. :thumbsup:
